name: Paper
author: contact@pixelcst.tech
description: Paper - performanter Minecraft-Java-Server. Aikar-Flags plus Compact Object Headers, optimierte Paper/Spigot/Bukkit-Konfiguration, Velocity-Forwarding per Panel. Die MOTD muss craftinghosting.free enthalten.
startup: if [ -f server.properties ] && ! grep -qiE "^motd=.*craftinghosting\.free" server.properties; then sed -i "/^motd=/d" server.properties; echo "motd=craftinghosting.free" >> server.properties; fi; VS="{{VELOCITY_SECRET}}"; PG=config/paper-global.yml; if [ -n "$VS" ]; then sed -i "s/^online-mode=.*/online-mode=false/" server.properties; if [ -f $PG ]; then sed -i -e "/^ \{2\}velocity:/,/^ \{0,2\}[^ ]/{s/^\( \{4\}\)enabled:.*/\1enabled: true/;s/^\( \{4\}\)secret:.*/\1secret: '$VS'/}" $PG; fi; elif [ -f $PG ]; then sed -i "/^ \{2\}velocity:/,/^ \{0,2\}[^ ]/s/^\( \{4\}\)enabled:.*/\1enabled: false/" $PG; fi; if [ "{{SERVER_MEMORY}}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then MEM="-Xms256M -Xmx$(({{SERVER_MEMORY}} - ({{SERVER_MEMORY}}/10)))M"; else MEM="-Xms256M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85"; fi; java -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions $MEM -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1HeapWastePercent=5 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dusing.aikars.flags=https://mcflags.emc.gs -Daikars.new.flags=true -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders {{CUSTOM_STARTUP}} -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}} nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Paper - Installations-/Update-Skript fuer Pterodactyl (Performance)
# Laeuft im Installer-Container (ghcr.io/pterodactyl/installers:alpine) unter /mnt/server

PROJECT=paper
API="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}"
USER_AGENT="craftinghosting-egg/1.0"
SERVER_DIR="${SERVER_DIR:-/mnt/server}"
SERVER_JARFILE="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"

if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apk add --no-cache curl jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}"
cd "${SERVER_DIR}" || exit 1

if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
    echo ">> Nutze eigene Download-URL: ${DL_PATH}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(eval echo "$(echo "${DL_PATH}" | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')")
    DOWNLOAD_SHA=""
else
    PROJECT_JSON=$(curl -fsSL -m 30 -A "${USER_AGENT}" "${API}")
    if [ -z "${PROJECT_JSON}" ]; then
        echo "!! PaperMC-API nicht erreichbar."
        exit 1
    fi
    # Neueste stabile Version (ohne -rc / -pre / Snapshots)
    LATEST_VERSION=$(printf "%s\n" "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r '[.versions[][]] | map(select(test("(?i)(rc|pre|snapshot|beta|alpha)") | not)) | first')

    if [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ] || [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
        MINECRAFT_VERSION="${LATEST_VERSION}"
    elif [ "$(printf "%s\n" "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r --arg V "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" '[.versions[][]] | index($V) != null')" != "true" ]; then
        echo ">> Version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} nicht gefunden - nutze neueste Version ${LATEST_VERSION}"
        MINECRAFT_VERSION="${LATEST_VERSION}"
    fi

    if [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] || [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" = "latest" ]; then
        BUILD_JSON=$(curl -fsSL -m 30 -A "${USER_AGENT}" "${API}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/latest")
    else
        BUILD_JSON=$(curl -fsSL -m 30 -A "${USER_AGENT}" "${API}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}" || true)
        if [ -z "${BUILD_JSON}" ] || [ "$(printf "%s\n" "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.id // empty')" = "" ]; then
            echo ">> Build ${BUILD_NUMBER} nicht gefunden - nutze neuesten Build"
            BUILD_JSON=$(curl -fsSL -m 30 -A "${USER_AGENT}" "${API}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/latest")
        fi
    fi
    BUILD_NUMBER=$(printf "%s\n" "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.id')
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(printf "%s\n" "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.downloads."server:default".url')
    DOWNLOAD_SHA=$(printf "%s\n" "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.downloads."server:default".checksums.sha256 // empty')

    echo ">> Projekt:    ${PROJECT}"
    echo ">> MC-Version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
    echo ">> Build:      ${BUILD_NUMBER} ($(printf "%s\n" "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.channel'))"
fi

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
    echo "!! Keine Download-URL gefunden."
    exit 1
fi

echo ">> Lade ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 -m 600 -A "${USER_AGENT}" -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}.new" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"; then
    rm -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}.new"
    echo "!! Download fehlgeschlagen."
    exit 1
fi
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_SHA}" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "${SERVER_JARFILE}.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "${DOWNLOAD_SHA}" ]; then
    rm -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}.new"
    echo "!! Pruefsumme stimmt nicht - Download beschaedigt."
    exit 1
fi
if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    mv -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old"
fi
mv -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}.new" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    echo ">> Lade Standard-server.properties"
    curl -fsSL -m 30 -A "${USER_AGENT}" -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties || touch server.properties
fi

# Performance-Konfiguration nur bei Neuinstallation (bestehende Dateien bleiben unangetastet)
if [ "${OPTIMIZE_CONFIGS:-true}" = "true" ]; then
    mkdir -p config
    if [ ! -f config/paper-world-defaults.yml ]; then
        echo ">> Lege optimierte config/paper-world-defaults.yml an"
        cat > config/paper-world-defaults.yml <<'YML'
# Performance-Voreinstellungen (craftinghosting.free). Paper ergaenzt fehlende Werte selbst.
chunks:
  max-auto-save-chunks-per-tick: 8
  prevent-moving-into-unloaded-chunks: true
  entity-per-chunk-save-limit:
    arrow: 16
    ender_pearl: 8
    experience_orb: 16
    fireball: 8
    small_fireball: 8
    snowball: 8
collisions:
  max-entity-collisions: 2
entities:
  armor-stands:
    do-collision-entity-lookups: false
environment:
  optimize-explosions: true
  treasure-maps:
    find-already-discovered:
      loot-tables: true
      villager-trade: true
misc:
  redstone-implementation: ALTERNATE_CURRENT
tick-rates:
  grass-spread: 4
  mob-spawner: 2
YML
    fi
    if [ ! -f spigot.yml ]; then
        echo ">> Lege optimierte spigot.yml an"
        cat > spigot.yml <<'YML'
# Performance-Voreinstellungen (craftinghosting.free). Spigot ergaenzt fehlende Werte selbst.
world-settings:
  default:
    entity-activation-range:
      animals: 16
      monsters: 24
      raiders: 48
      misc: 8
      water: 8
      villagers: 16
      flying-monsters: 48
      tick-inactive-villagers: false
    merge-radius:
      item: 3.0
      exp: 4.0
YML
    fi
    if [ ! -f bukkit.yml ]; then
        echo ">> Lege optimierte bukkit.yml an"
        cat > bukkit.yml <<'YML'
# Performance-Voreinstellungen (craftinghosting.free). Bukkit ergaenzt fehlende Werte selbst.
spawn-limits:
  monsters: 50
  animals: 8
  water-animals: 3
  water-ambient: 1
  water-underground-creature: 3
  axolotls: 3
  ambient: 1
ticks-per:
  monster-spawns: 4
YML
    fi
fi

# Velocity-Block vorbereiten, damit er beim Start gesetzt werden kann
mkdir -p config
if [ ! -f config/paper-global.yml ]; then
    cat > config/paper-global.yml <<'YML'
# Paper ergaenzt fehlende Werte selbst. Velocity wird ueber das Panel gesteuert.
proxies:
  velocity:
    enabled: false
    online-mode: true
    secret: ''
YML
fi

echo ">> Installation abgeschlossen."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Minecraft-Version, z.B. 26.3 oder 1.21.11. 'latest' = neueste stabile Version. Ungueltige Versionen fallen auf latest zurueck.

variables.name: Download Path
variables.description: Eigene Download-URL statt PaperMC. Nicht fuer Nutzer sichtbar.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: Paper-Build. 'latest' = neuester Build. Ungueltige Builds fallen auf latest zurueck.

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Beschreibung in der Serverliste. Pflicht: muss 'craftinghosting.free' enthalten.

variables.name: Sichtweite
variables.description: Sichtweite in Chunks (Vanilla: 10). Groesster Hebel fuer RAM/CPU.

variables.name: Simulationsdistanz
variables.description: In wie vielen Chunks um Spieler Mobs/Redstone/Pflanzen berechnet werden (Vanilla: 10).

variables.name: Online-Modus
variables.description: Nur gekaufte Minecraft-Konten (true/false). Wird bei Velocity automatisch auf false gesetzt.

variables.name: Kompressions-Schwelle
variables.description: Pakete ab dieser Groesse (Byte) werden komprimiert. Hinter Velocity auf -1 setzen.

variables.name: Velocity-Secret
variables.description: Inhalt der forwarding.secret des Velocity-Proxys. Gesetzt = Velocity-Modern-Forwarding an und online-mode aus. Leer = aus.

variables.name: Optimierte Konfiguration
variables.description: Bei der Installation optimierte paper-world-defaults.yml, spigot.yml und bukkit.yml anlegen (nur wenn noch nicht vorhanden).
